name: refactor_go_duplicated_env_checks_to_helper
description: Extracts duplicated required-environment-variable boilerplate into a shared requireEnv helper
prompts: config.go defines LoadDatabaseURL, LoadAPIKey, and LoadRegion, each reading one environment variable via os.Getenv and returning the IDENTICAL error `fmt.Errorf("missing required environment variable: %s", name)` when it's empty. Refactor config.go to remove this duplication: add a helper `func requireEnv(name string) (string, error)` that performs the getenv-and-check-empty logic once, and have all three Load* functions call it with their own variable name instead of repeating the pattern. Keep every function's signature and behavior identical: each must still return the value when set and the exact same error message (naming its OWN variable) when the corresponding environment variable is unset or empty.

test_setup_files.check_dedup.py:
import re

source = open('config.go', encoding='utf-8').read()
# Match the error FORMAT STRING literal, not a fully-rendered message (which
# would legitimately appear once per call site even after a correct
# refactor) - the format string itself must appear only once, inside one
# shared helper, not once per Load* function.
occurrences = len(re.findall(r'missing required environment variable: %s', source))
assert occurrences <= 1, (
    f'the error format string still appears {occurrences} times - it must be extracted into '
    f'one shared helper (e.g. requireEnv), not repeated per function')
print('PASS')
